title: NN2FPGA: Optimizing CNN Inference on FPGAs With Binary Integer Programming
authors: Roberto Bosio; Filippo Minnella; Teodoro Urso; Mario R. Casu; Luciano Lavagno; Mihai T. Lazarescu; Paolo Pasini
verify_method: crossref title+authors+year match; OA PDF fetched and read
what_it_does: HLS layer-pipelined dataflow compiler (Brevitas/QONNX -> Vitis HLS) with BIP-based per-layer parallelism allocation; INT8/INT4 ResNet8/ResNet20 CIFAR-10 on KV260 and Ultra96, MobileNetV2 ImageNet on ZCU102; skip-connection buffering optimizations; whole-board power from rail sensors.
not_found_in_sections_read: cycle-exact model-vs-board agreement; latency guarantees/WCET; sparsity skipping; bit-exact RTL-vs-golden claim; the analytic latency model (Eq. 14) explicitly ignores pipeline depth and is used only for DSE

notes: The single most relevant prior custom KV260 ResNet-20 INT8 design: 7601 FPS, 0.318 ms, 6.10 W, 91.3%. Throughput-oriented (batch 1000).
